en: A vintage multi-view postcard printed in sepia tones. The top panel shows a panoramic view over a rural and suburban landscape with scattered houses and fields, captioned at the top edge. The middle panel depicts a two‑storey building with shutters, housing a general store and tobacco shop with several adults and children posed in front. The bottom panel shows a village street scene lined with houses and trees, with a few people standing along the road.
